name: What kind of maintenance is required after replacing siding around windows?

mainEntity.name: What kind of maintenance is required after replacing siding around windows?

acceptedAnswer.text: After replacing siding around windows, minimal maintenance is typically required, depending on the material used. Regularly inspect the caulking and sealant around the window frames for any cracks or deterioration, especially after extreme weather, and reapply as needed. Keep gutters clean to ensure proper drainage and prevent water accumulation near window areas. For fiber cement or engineered wood, occasional cleaning with a mild detergent can help maintain appearance. Following these steps ensures the longevity and effectiveness of the new siding.
acceptedAnswer.description: Regularly inspect and maintain caulking, keep gutters clean, and perform occasional cleaning to ensure the longevity of your new siding around windows.
